verdict_reason: Four gates pass. G2-E is partial: its auditor leg (independent read-only review of the actual WSL repository files) could not be performed because the Lead session runs in the Windows opencode.exe domain and the auditor was denied external_directory access to every WSL path. The design states inline-only review is not an acceptable P2 independent file review.
defects_fixed: torchrl Binary is int8 while the env emits bool; boolean leaves use Unbounded(dtype=torch.bool) so the spec matches truthful data (check_env_specs had failed on dtype mismatch)
nested players Composite required the full [N,2] shape, not [2]
independent oracle re-derived its seed after episode_id incremented, replaying the wrong episode; now records used_seed/used_teams
partial reset used reset_batch, invalidating untouched handles; now uses reset_slots_batch on masked slots only
truncation was counted as a completed match (guard was 'term or trunc'); completion now requires term, truncation tracked separately with no payout (found by read-only review)
limitations: Auditor never read the WSL repository; G2-E audit conjunct unmet
Only 4 seeded games, exactly the G2-B minimum
Oracle is a second native engine but shares the PA4 decoder path, so decoder bugs would be invisible
CPU native stepping only; no GPU simulation or throughput claim
Max observed legal candidates 18 is an inherited fixture bound, not a global maximum
P1 policy remains randomly initialised (seed 20261006); no strength claim
No benchmark or performance optimisation performed
P1 replay still requires the original observation payload
PA3 pin is the public main tip, not verified live production state
test_commands: uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests/environment -t .
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests/action_distribution -t .
notes: One step per native advance attempt; never one step per branch choice and never one step per match.
match_completed is emitted at most once per naturally terminated episode; truncated episodes are not counted as matches.
player_view(seat) is the only policy-facing extraction and returns that seat's own observation only.
No P3 collector, PPO, profiling or cloud work was performed.
The P2 execution prompt file named in the task does not exist on this machine; work followed PA4-P2-DESIGN-v1.0, which is the authoritative design.
